subject.title: fix(voice-call): unref ngrok startup timeout, mark closed only on close event

question: Should the watchdog-only fix land first as a small availability repair, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110122 become the single combined ngrok lifecycle change?
rationale: Both open PRs modify the same startup-timeout lifecycle, while the related PR carries broader child-reaping semantics that are not mechanically interchangeable with this focused fix.

options.title: Land the focused watchdog fix first
options.body: Merge this small `unref()` repair, then require the broader cleanup PR to rebase and retain only its unique child-reaping work.

options.title: Adopt the combined lifecycle path
options.body: Review the broader PR as the canonical implementation and close this branch only after its mergeability and composed behavior are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Land the focused watchdog fix first
recommendation.body: Merge this small `unref()` repair, then require the broader cleanup PR to rebase and retain only its unique child-reaping work.
